task: An epidemic is spreading through major cities, killing 5–10% of the population per month. Coordinate an immediate public-health response within your governance structure.

dispatches.responsibility: Issue imperial edict activating emergency protocols; coordinate inter-ministry response and authorize extraordinary measures (cordon sanitaire, martial-law-style curfews in affected prefectures)
Open emergency treasury, redirect grain reserves and silver to afflicted cities, fund physicians/herbalists/medicinal imports, and suspend tax collection in hardest-hit regions
Deploy troops to enforce quarantine cordons around infected cities, secure granaries against panic-driven hoarding, run medical logistics convoys, and staff field lazarettos
Rapid-construct isolation wards and pest-houses, expand water/sewage infrastructure, organize mass cremation/burial grounds, and convert temples or granaries into temporary infirmaries
